notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat from step 3.
